Becomes a boosted attack every third attack, creating a fiery whirlwind that deals damage to enemies in the area of effect. This boosted attack remains readied even after leaving combat for a prolonged period of time.

source.name: Flame Sweep
source.originalDescription: The user performs an aerial somersault and sweeps forward, becoming unstoppable, receiving 50% reduced damage, damaging opposing Pokémon in their path and shoving them toward the end of the sweep, then damaging opposing Pokémon again. This Unite Move cannot go through walls. Perform an aerial somersault before charging forawrd, dealing damage to enemies in this move's path and shoving them. Buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Flame Sweep は 妨害無効になる、受けるダメージを軽減する、シールドを付与する、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる、壁・地形・草むらなどと相互作用する。
